notes: Tuition not extracted: the pages do not tie this programme to a specific fee group, and the reduced fixed fee for non-OECD countries is not used because no accepted quote ties Morocco (it is listed in the non-OECD annex PDF, but that annex is a country list, not a fee amount quote). The programme page states 'Restricted access - entrance exam (240 places available)' while the how-to-enrol page states 'Admission to the degree programme is limited to 190 places, 32 of which are reserved for non-EU citizens resident abroad and 13 to Special Programmes.' Application deadlines for the 2026/27 call are given for first selection '10 February 2026 to 4 May 2026, 1:00pm', but the page does not state these are for non-EU applicants residing abroad, so no intakes fact is included; more selection rounds exist.

note.fr: L'admission est subordonnée à un test d'entrée (SAT General test) et à un nombre limité de places; consultez l'appel à candidatures officiel pour les détails et les dates.
note.en: Admission requires an entrance exam (SAT General test) and places are limited; check the official call for details and dates.

evidence.quote: The selection of applicants is based on the SAT General test, which is an international test in English, completely managed by CollegeBoard and stands for “Scholastic Assessment Test.”
